extDescription.message: Detects unprotected videos on the current page and prepares them for download.

emptyHint.message: Press play: many sites only load the media once playback starts.

drmExplanation.message: Encrypted content (DRM). It cannot legally be downloaded.

unsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be analyzed (internal browser page).

needsCompanion.message: HLS/DASH downloads arrive with the companion app (Sprint 3).

errorForbidden.message: The server refused the direct download (hotlink protection). The companion app will handle this.

errorExpired.message: The link expired. Reload the page, press play and try again.

errorNetwork.message: The connection dropped during the download.

errorFileAccess.message: The file could not be written. Check the folder in the options.

errorUnknown.message: The download failed for an unknown reason.

refusalNotFound.message: This media is no longer listed. Reload the page.

refusalFailed.message: The browser refused to start the download.

optionsFolderHint.message: Leave empty to save directly to Downloads. For security, the browser does not allow writing outside that folder.

optionsAskLabel.message: Ask where to save each file
